title: Find the Bug: Clock Divider
statement: A clock divider module is provided with a bug that causes an incorrect duty cycle. Your task is to fix the design so the output clock toggles every N input cycles and has a 50% duty cycle when N is even. The corrected module should use synchronous counters.
module_signature: module find_bug_clock_divider(input clk, input rst, input [3:0] n, output reg clk_out);
behavior: clk_out toggles every n input cycles.
clk_out should be low after reset until enough cycles accumulate.
All state updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
rst is active-high and synchronous unless the problem statement explicitly says otherwise.
Use non-blocking assignments in clocked always blocks.
Outputs must never depend on uninitialized x/z state after reset.
When rst is asserted on a rising edge, registered outputs reset to their documented initial values.
constraints: Do not use asynchronous feedback or combinational loops.
hint: Count input cycles and toggle the output using a registered counter.
